blocks.text: REDUCE THE PAIN IN YOUR MUSCLES AND JOINTS

blocks.html: Victory Medical provides state-of-the-art physical therapy and rehabilitation for pain management, neurological ailments, and the treatment of musculoskeletal injuries including sprains, strains, fractures, dislocations, and post-surgical needs.

Physical therapy is a comprehensive approach to healing your body. Patient education, therapeutic exercise, and prevention strategies all play important roles in our holistic approach to patient-centered healing therapies designed to speed recovery and reduce the likelihood recurring injuries.

If you have spent years typing or doing other repetitive hand motions in your job, you may sometimes notice a tingling or numbness in the palm of your hand or in your fingers. These symptoms may be carpal tunnel syndrome. The medical director and founder of Victory Medical, Dr. William Franklin, built the practice to provide you with integrated care through both traditional and holistic methods, ensuring you see results and reduce your pain.
Wrist braces or splints for mild cases to hold your wrist in place, particularly while sleeping.
Steroid injections or cortisone pills help reduce swelling and inflammation.
Physical therapy to stretch and strengthen the muscles in your hand and wrist.
Therapy of inserting tiny needles into specified parts of the body to increase balance and well-being.
POST SURGERY, POST INJURY, OR AGE RELATED PHYSICAL STRENGTHENING THERAPY

blocks.text: GET YOUR MUSCLES BACK TO OPTIMAL STRENGTH

blocks.html: The stronger your muscles are, the more support your body has to move through life fluidly without injury. The physical therapists at Victory Medical provide you with the information and training to help improve your overall strength. Whether you’re recovering from an injury, managing a disability, or training for a big event, physical therapy offers many strength-building benefits.

blocks.text: UNDERSTANDING HOW YOUR BODY SHOULD MOVE

blocks.html: The more you know about the way your body moves and functions, the more aware you are of your everyday movements. By educating patients on the fundamentals of kinesiology, providers at Victory Medical can help them be more conscientious of their movements and prevent future injuries from occurring.

blocks.text: MAINTAIN AND PROTECT YOUR HEALTH IN YOUR WORKSPACE

blocks.html: With advances in technology, sedentary office jobs continue to become more prevalent, and unless workstations are correctly or ergonomically set up, more and more people are experiencing posture-related pain. Many companies are taking the initiative to provide ergonomically correct workstations to promote good posture and prevent neck and back pain from developing. Victory Medical offers workstation ergonomics education and optimization to get relief for joint and muscle pain.
